why: Puts `tanks.touch.v1` back in the EXPORT list in place of `tanks.settings.v1`. Nothing in the tree writes the legacy key any more, so this produces exports that carry stale bytes and omit the settings a player actually has. Killed broadly -- the SAVE_KEYS literal, the 'does NOT export the legacy touch key' guard, the measured store-coverage check, the round trips, and loop.test.ts's dev-console key list. 10 of 400 across the three declared files; the wide population is the point, since this key list is the wire format several suites read through.
